    Claim: "The LQC low-ℓ deviation is NEGATIVE (suppression); the framework's low-ℓ deviation is ~0 (baseline: no feature) OR of definite computed sign; the SIGN PAIR is the discriminator."

    Step 1 (definitions):

    Step 4 (canonical form — read off the sign pair):

    Step 5 (direction):
